game.title: Ekka-Dokka
game.description: A traditional hopscotch variant primarily played by girls, using a broken piece of earthen pot (guti). Players hop through numbered boxes while singing a melodious rhyme, kicking the guti through each section.
equipment: Chalk or stick to draw boxes
howToPlay: Step 1: Draw a large rectangle divided into six boxes on the ground.
Step 2: Name the boxes: ek-er ghor (first), dui-er ghor (second), etc., with the last called samundra.
Step 3: Players roll their guti into the first box while standing outside.
Step 4: Hop on one foot and kick the guti from box to box in sequence.
Step 5: Continue until reaching the fifth box, then return to start.
Step 6: After completing, roll the guti to the second box and repeat.
Step 7: Players sing the ekka-dokka melody throughout the game.
Step 8: Elimination occurs if guti lands on a line, wrong box, or both feet touch ground.
Step 9: The player who completes all boxes successfully wins.
Step 10: Advanced players add complex patterns and faster movements.
